observations: Strong one-shot execution: a single model call with no tool use produced a complete, polished experience.
Clear art direction: Capy Cruise and the No hurry. Just hover. framing give the piece a consistent editorial identity instead of a generic demo.
Constraint compliance: the result is a self-contained HTML document with inline SVG, CSS, and JavaScript and no external assets, libraries, fonts, or network requests.
Layered motion includes hovering, leaning, scarf and leaf movement, blinking, cloud drift, glow, shadow, streaks, and boost feedback.
Good accessibility basics include SVG title and description, labeled controls, visible focus states, live mood text, and reduced-motion support.
The main limitation is shallow interaction: the speed control mostly changes streak timing while the rider remains spatially fixed, and boost is a timed animation rather than a deeper movement model.
Mobile support deliberately crops and enlarges the landscape to preserve focus on the rider at the expense of showing the full scene.
